name: BloodHound CE - Essential Cypher Queries
description: A set of high-value Cypher queries for BloodHound CE: find paths from owned users to high-value targets, list outbound control edges, Kerberoastable/AS-REP-roastable users, shadow-credential and RBCD opportunities, and DCSync principals. Paste into the BloodHound CE Cypher search box.
notes:
=== MARK OWNED FIRST ===
Right-click a node -> Mark as Owned, or in Cypher:
  MATCH (u:User {name:'<USER>@<DOMAIN>'}) SET u.owned=true

=== 1. Shortest path from owned to high value ===
  MATCH (u {owned:true}) MATCH p=shortestPath((u)-[*1..]->(t {highvalue:true})) RETURN p

=== 2. All outbound object control from your user ===
  MATCH p=(u:User {name:'<USER>@<DOMAIN>'})-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner|Owns|AddMember|ForceChangePassword|AddKeyCredentialLink*1..]->(n) RETURN p

=== 3. Kerberoastable users ===
  MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.hasspn=true RETURN u.name, u.serviceprincipalnames

=== 4. AS-REP roastable users ===
  MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.dontreqpreauth=true RETURN u.name

=== 5. Shadow-cred opportunities (write over msDS-KeyCredentialLink) ===
  MATCH p=(n)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|AddKeyCredentialLink]->(t) RETURN p

=== 6. RBCD opportunities (write over a computer) ===
  MATCH p=(n)-[:GenericAll|GenericWrite|WriteDacl|WriteOwner]->(c:Computer) RETURN p

=== 7. Principals that can DCSync ===
  MATCH p=(n)-[:DCSync|GetChanges|GetChangesAll|AllExtendedRights]->(d:Domain) RETURN p

=== 8. Users with a path to Domain Admins ===
  MATCH p=shortestPath((u:User)-[*1..]->(g:Group)) WHERE g.name STARTS WITH 'DOMAIN ADMINS' RETURN p LIMIT 25

=== 9. Computers where Domain Users are local admin ===
  MATCH p=(g:Group)-[:AdminTo]->(c:Computer) WHERE g.name STARTS WITH 'DOMAIN USERS' RETURN p

=== 10. Sessions of high-value users ===
  MATCH p=(c:Computer)-[:HasSession]->(u:User) WHERE u.highvalue=true RETURN p

=== 11. Unconstrained delegation ===
  MATCH (c) WHERE c.unconstraineddelegation=true RETURN c.name

=== 12. Owned principals with local admin somewhere ===
  MATCH p=(u {owned:true})-[:AdminTo|MemberOf*1..]->(c:Computer) RETURN p

recommended.note: Turn the control edges you found into concrete attacks.

explain:
A set of raw Cypher queries you paste into the BloodHound CE Neo4j console to surface attack paths the GUI does not show by default:
  MATCH (u:User {owned:true})   start from accounts you have already marked as owned
  shortestPath(...->(t:Group {highvalue:true}))   the fewest hops to a high-value group (e.g. Domain Admins)
  RETURN p                       render that path as a graph
Other queries in the set list outbound control edges, Kerberoastable/AS-REP-roastable users, shadow-credential and RBCD opportunities, and DCSync principals - so you pick the next abuse from live graph data instead of guessing.
